row: VNN is a network of veterinarians who contribute to their local news media (print, radio and TV News). These 2 minute TV News stories you see here are basic resources for these veterinary reporters to use in their local media. We help educate, inform and motivate pet owners to see their veterinarians for professional pet care.  We also certify veterinary journalists for broadcast credibility through the American Society of Veterinary Journalists (www.ASVJ.org)
